answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 8 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the nadir hash is stored at intake, the violet graph groups the endorsements and the inlet audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 158 aliases hence pays for 158 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
